fences.rule: Introducer's tab presupposes that map's Vouching, reputation staked on another's behalf, and adds the shape of the rate: the converter pays, so credit moves only as fast as someone will be billed for it.
fences.case: The referee whose letter opens the door and who is billed if the hire goes badly.

fences.rule: If the item is the instrument that lets the save leave a trace at all, it belongs there; if it is what the witnessed save converts competence into, and at what rate against a credential, it is here.
fences.case: The night nurse who caught the tenfold dose and is deferred to by physicians for years afterward.

fences.rule: If the power that shields the holder is obsolete and obeyed by habit, it belongs there; if the institution's memory and other people's careers still run through the holder so that removal costs more than tolerance, it is here.
fences.case: The thirty-year clerk forgiven what a newcomer would be fired for.
